storagePolicy: No clinical response data may be persisted in GitHub.
presentationPolicy: Public URLs must always resolve to an ecosystem-owned clinical interface. External collection engines may receive submissions in the background, but their native interface, branding and direct response URLs must never be the patient-facing experience.
experiencePolicy: All patient-facing screenings use the ICAPS-derived design system, patient-friendly public naming, short storytelling/onboarding and the identity fields Nome completo, Data de nascimento and Data de aplicação do rastreio. Items, answer options and scoring logic remain unchanged until separately validated.
